findings.motion: On adoption of amendment #1587 (H.5500), recorded vote 27 yeas to 131 nays; amendment rejected
findings.note: Amendment 1587 to the FY2027 budget, titled 'An Act relative to identification to vote', would have required valid state or federal photo ID before a voter receives a ballot, with a free state photo ID for registered voters without one who sign an affidavit. Michlewitz is recorded as N on the roll call.
